From: Teresa Gomez <tgomez@finvest.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-03-11T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace private offer — billing & annex questions

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the demo yesterday. Procurement has a few quick clarifying items before we can issue the PO for the Azure private offer:

- Can you confirm which legal entity Redwood will invoice (we need legal name + tax ID to place the PO)?
- We reviewed the commercial annex you shared. We have a couple of redline asks around invoice timing (Net 45), acceptance criteria, and an explicit invoice routing address for AP. Can you accept Net 45?
- We require SOC 2 Type II evidence and a recent pen test summary to satisfy our security review — can you provide those artifacts or a summary?
- For the private listing SKU mapping: can you confirm whether the SKU supports subsystem entitlements for multiple business units under one account?

I’ve attached our standard procurement sheet for your reference (I will attach vendor PO template once we get entity details). Ideally we’d like to close commercial terms this week.

Best,
Teresa
Procurement Manager
FinVest Capital
teresa.gomez@finvest.com

Attachment: finvest_procurement_template.xlsx (stub)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-03-11T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer — annex redlines (internal)

Ben / Markus,

I reviewed commercial_annex_redline_v2.docx and added comments inline. Key points:

- Indemnity: FinVest is asking for a fairly broad indemnity. We should cap liability to the greater of $5M or 2x fees for the term; propose redline.
- Data processing: add the Redwood DPA (short form) as an exhibit rather than expanding the annex. This keeps Marketplace flow simpler.
- Invoice terms: Net 45 is acceptable from a commercial perspective; finance will accept Net 45 for enterprise deals under $1M ARR, otherwise we push for Net 30. Ask finance if this deal forecast is >$1M.
- SOC2 & pen test: we can share a SOC 2 summary and a redacted pen test summary via secure link. Full reports require a CDA/NDA in our standard transfer system.

I attached a marked-up annex and put suggested language for the indemnity cap and DPA exhibit. I also called out a needed clause around marketplace SKU entitlement mapping so Marketplace Ops can configure the SKU to support sub-account entitlements.

-L
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference
Attachment: commercial_annex_redline_v2_laura_comments.docx (stub)
